authoritative_source: Milan et al., MOT16: A Benchmark for Multi-Object Tracking (2016), Table 6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1603.00831
description: Provisional MOT17 source-to-common class mapping for Stage 1. Native labels are normalised to lower-case snake case without broader semantic collapse.
notes: The authoritative source defines native class identifiers 1 to 12.
Unknown identifiers are rejected because no evidence supports an implicit 'other' mapping.
The common values remain provisional pending review against KITTI Tracking.
